title: Latin Q4 derivative census, Hoffman four-cell triality refinement, D4/tomotope square-face action, and orbital-fusion geometry
purpose: Continue after closed Pass5308-5315. Pass5316: classify all 576 order-4 Latin squares by constant Q4 coordinate derivatives and prove the 144 Klein class is exactly affine on F2^4. Pass5317: refine the ten Hoffman four-cell orbits under canonical W(D4), recording the exact triality triple-splitting. Pass5318: identify the characteristic tomotope96 subgroup inside the Latin-even affine group and compute its five-spread-line action, with outer C3 cycling row/column/symbol. Pass5319: build the natural W(D4)/Z action on the 12 antipodal square-face pairs of the tesseract and compare it explicitly to the published tomotope degree-12 action. Pass5320: contrast the orientation-preserving tesseract quotient on the same 12 objects by orbital fusion. Pass5321-5323: consolidate the 3K4 coordinate-partition geometry, regressions, manuscript/site integration, and theorem firewalls.
boundary: Do not infer group identities from equal orders. Keep W(D4) and the tesseract rotation group distinct. The tomotope comparison uses explicit degree-12 conjugacy and orbital certificates. Hoffman shortened distance, q11 footprint distance, and all-odd rank theorem remain open.
